rules.text: Items can be returned within 90 days of purchase for a full refund with original receipt or online order confirmation.
rules.quote: Items can be returned **within 90 days of purchase** to any Five Below location for a full refund to the original payment method – just bring the original receipt or online order confirmation!

rules.text: Original receipt or online order confirmation is required for returns or exchanges.
rules.quote: we gladly accept exchanges or returns* for unopened or defective merchandise with the original receipt.
rules.reviewNote: The quote specifies that a receipt is required for returns or exchanges of unopened or defective merchandise, but the summary omits these conditions and overstates the policy by implying all returns/exchanges require a receipt regardless of item condition.

rules.text: Refunds will be credited to the original debit/credit card used for purchase; card must be present to receive refund.
rules.quote: Refunds will be credited to the original debit/credit card used for purchase (card must be present to receive refund).

rules.text: Five Below does not reimburse the cost of shipping for online returns or provide return shipment labels.
rules.quote: Five Below does not reimburse the cost of shipping for online returns or provide return shipment labels.
